body: we also experience this error when webapp makes a promisified call like ~150 times.
I see this error too. any hints?
Great find @virtualgraham - need to confirm with @lucasfernog though if this creates other unexpected side effects.
I think this won't work on Windows. I'll investigate this.
Hmm I can't reproduce this on my Linux. Will try on mac later.
Yep, I should have mentioned that this problem is happening on macOS

Yes, it does work with `configurable: true`. That may be the solution. Why do you think this is happening? Also What code are you using to reproduce the problem? It happens for me on Ubuntu and Mac.

If I had to guess, with `configurable: false`, it is being optimized in js engine in such a way that does not expect the property to be deleted.

I have no idea, seems like the problem only happens after some time? Maybe it's an invalid property name and it won't happen with me since it's random, i don't know. I was using the `bar` and `foo` function examples from above to try to reproduce it.

If configurable as true fix it, then we should just PR it and hope it doesn't happen anymore.

How can i modify tauri locally to try this change? I can't get tauri to rebuild inside my node_modules :( 

Edit: I can do `npm run build:api` in `tauri` after trying the change and I can confirm the error goes way on MacOS. Thanks guys :)
I can reproduce it with the `readTooManyDirectories` call and it seems like `configurable: true` is the fix here. I'll PR it.
